relationships.subject: necrostatin-1s
relationships.evidence_quote: this study aims to determine the effect of necrostatin (Nec) -1s, a selective RIPK1 inhibitor, on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced inflammatory pain and related underlying mechanisms

relationships.subject: necrostatin-1s
relationships.evidence_quote: The LPS-induced alleviation of thermal hyperalgesia was prevented by necrostatin-1s.

relationships.subject: necrostatin-1s
relationships.evidence_quote: Necrostatin-1s reversed (1) increased activity of RIPK1, RIPK3, MLKL, and NF-kB p65, (2) enhanced expression of TLR4, MyD88, TRIF, NF-kB p65, HMGB1, NLRP3, ASC, caspase-1 p20, IL-1β, caspase-11 p20, p30-GSDMD, and semaphorin 3A, and (3) diminished myelin PLP expression induced by LPS.

key_findings: Necrostatin-1s reversed LPS-induced increases in TLR4, HMGB1, NLRP3, caspase-1, caspase-11 and GSDMD signaling.
RIPK1 inhibition is proposed as an approach for inflammatory pain involving necroptosis, pyroptosis and demyelination.
